posts.name: Nunleft
posts.cooked:
I have tried (using mostly Rook City and Insula Primalis for environment, with some megalopolis):

  • Having Mr. Fixer defeat the Chairman and the Operative (both with crowbars and jackhandle)
  • Defeating the 5 underbosses AND the Operative in a single round (with Legacy, Fixer and Expat in party)
  • Defeating the Matriarch without removing anything from the board
  • Killing the Matriarch's Mask and her two Cohorts in the same turn
  • Playing all of Mr. Fixer's Styles
  • Playing (and Unloading) all of Expat's guns
  • Defeating Citizen Dawn (after she flips) with Expat in my party in Insula Primalis. (This was in response to the nemisis quote)
  • I blew up the T-rex and used the explosion to kill a pterydactyl
  • I had the terrydactyl steal some of expat's equipment... then blew it up with an RPG
  • tried getting Legacy, Tachyon and Ra infected.
  • I tried defeating Mad Bomber Baron Blade with the Freedom Five (switching Legacy with Young Legacy)
  • I tried pretty much every combination of legacy powers with legacy ring. have not tried with him/her emboldened
  • I've tried getting a 5 team infected

I am very much stumped. Hats off to Handelabra for making this hard, back to the drawing board.
